title: Sections of the colimit sheaf on a colimit of sites (degree 0)
statement: In the situation of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] (a cofiltered category $\mathcal I$, sites $\mathcal C_i$ whose coverings have finite index sets, morphisms of sites $f_a:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$ for $a:j\to i$ given by continuous functors $u_a:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_j$ with $u_b\circ u_a=u_{a\circ b}$, the colimit site $\mathcal C=\varinjlim\mathcal C_i$ with the canonical functors $u_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C$, $u_j\circ u_a=u_i$, and the morphisms of sites $f_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C_i$ they define [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]), let $\mathcal F_i$ be a sheaf on $\mathcal C_i$ for every $i$ and, for $a:j\to i$, $\varphi_a:f_a^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_j$ a map of sheaves on $\mathcal C_j$ with $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}_i}=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F_i}$ (under $f_{\mathrm{id}_i}^{-1}=\mathrm{id}$) and $\varphi_{a\circ b}=\varphi_b\circ f_b^{-1}\varphi_a$ (where $f_{a\circ b}^{-1}=f_b^{-1}f_a^{-1}$ via the canonical isomorphism of left adjoints); the maps $f_j^{-1}\varphi_a$ make $(f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i)$ a system over $\mathcal I^{\mathrm{op}}$ (filtered), and $\mathcal F=\varinjlim f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For $i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal I)$ and $X_i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C_i)$ consider the system $(\mathcal F_j(u_a(X_i)))_{a:j\to i}$ indexed by the category of arrows $a:j\to i$ (a cofiltered category, so the colimit is filtered), with transition map for $b:k\to j$ the composite $\mathcal F_j(u_a(X_i))\to(f_b^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_b(u_a(X_i)))\xrightarrow{\varphi_b}\mathcal F_k(u_{a\circ b}(X_i))$, the first arrow the unit of $f_b^{-1}\dashv f_{b*}$ at $u_a(X_i)$ ($f_{b*}=u_b^s$). Then the maps $\mathcal F_j(u_a(X_i))\to(f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_j(u_a(X_i)))=(f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_i(X_i))\to\mathcal F(u_i(X_i))$ (unit of $f_j^{-1}\dashv f_{j*}$, then the coprojection) induce a bijection $\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}\mathcal F_j(u_a(X_i))\to\mathcal F(u_i(X_i))$. The same holds for abelian sheaves $\mathcal F_i$ and maps $\varphi_a$ of abelian sheaves, the colimit $\mathcal F$ taken in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$, and the bijection is then an isomorphism of abelian groups.

proof.text: For $a:j\to i$ and $b:k\to j$, let $t_b$ be the displayed composite from $\mathcal F_j(u_aX_i)$ to $\mathcal F_k(u_{a\circ b}X_i)$. Naturality of the adjunction unit, the canonical identification $f_{a\circ b}^{-1}=f_b^{-1}f_a^{-1}$, and $\varphi_{a\circ b}=\varphi_b\circ f_b^{-1}\varphi_a$ give $t_{b\circ c}=t_c\circ t_b$; the added hypothesis $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}}=\mathrm{id}$ and the unit for the identity adjunction give $t_{\mathrm{id}}=\mathrm{id}$. Thus these sets and maps form the asserted filtered diagram. The same calculation after applying $f_j^{-1}$ shows that the maps $f_j^{-1}\varphi_a$ form the diagram of sheaves whose colimit is $\mathcal F$, and naturality of the units and coprojections shows that the maps in the statement form a map from the first colimit to $\mathcal F(u_iX_i)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09YN (lemma-colimit), hypotheses and the transition maps implicit in its two colimits; the identity condition needed for an honest diagram is supplied explicitly

proof.text: There is a canonical isomorphism $\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}\mathcal F_j(u_aX_i)\cong\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}\varinjlim_{b:k\to j}(f_b^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_{a\circ b}X_i)$. In the forward direction, the component at $a$ is the coprojection into the inner colimit for $b=\mathrm{id}_j$, after the unit identification $\mathcal F_j(u_aX_i)=(f_{\mathrm{id}_j}^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_aX_i)$. In the reverse direction, the component indexed by $(a,b)$ is $\varphi_b$ evaluated at $u_{a\circ b}X_i$, followed by the coprojection of $\mathcal F_k(u_{a\circ b}X_i)$ into the outer colimit at $a\circ b$. The universal properties of the two colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] make these maps well defined: compatibility in $a$ and $b$ is precisely naturality of the units and the cocycle equation. Their composites are identities because $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}}=\mathrm{id}$, and, for a general pair $(a,b)$, the inner coprojection is identified with the identity-stage coprojection at $a\circ b$ by the transition map indexed by $b$; equality can equivalently be checked with the element criterion for filtered colimits [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise]. This writes out the source's 'formal argument'.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09YN, first displayed equality ('A formal argument shows that ...')

proof.text: Fix $a:j\to i$. Apply the inverse-image formula of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] (Tag 0A35) at the stage $j$, to the sheaf $\mathcal F_j$ and the object $u_a(X_i)\in\mathcal C_j$. Since $u_j(u_aX_i)=u_iX_i$ and $u_b(u_aX_i)=u_{a\circ b}X_i$, it identifies the inner colimit of step 2 with $(f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_iX_i)$, compatibly with the outer transition maps and coprojections. Hence step 2 gives $\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}\mathcal F_j(u_aX_i)\cong\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}(f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_iX_i)$, and the resulting map is the unit-then-coprojection map of the statement.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09YN, application of equation (equation-compute-pullback-to-limit) from Lemma Tag 0A35

proof.text: Every covering of the colimit site $\mathcal C$ is the image of a finite covering at some stage, hence has finite index set [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-filtered-colimit-sections-finite-coverings] to the filtered diagram $(f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)_{a:j\to i}$ on $\mathcal C$ and the object $u_iX_i$: the canonical map $\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}(f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_iX_i)\to(\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)(u_iX_i)=\mathcal F(u_iX_i)$ is a bijection. Composing with step 3 proves the assertion. The same proof in abelian sheaves uses the abelian clause of that lemma and the abelian inverse-image formula in [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites]; every map in steps 1-3 is a homomorphism, so the resulting bijection is an isomorphism of abelian groups.
